description: Agent Education: submit a diploma or degree certificate with the conferral record: the diploma with its institution, holder, degree, field of study, conferral date, honors as printed, the day issued and its number; the conferral record with its institution, holder, degree, field of study, conferral date, honors and status (conferred, pending, rescinded or not conferred). The signed report gives the diploma and the conferral record, the holder, degree and field on each side read as matching or differing, the conferral date printed and recorded with the day issued, and the honors printed and recorded read as matching, differing, unrecorded or omitted, and counts them, and names a mismatched diploma: a conferral record that shows the degree pending, rescinded or not conferred, a holder, degree, field of study or conferral date unlike the record, and honors the record does not show; then recorded honors left off, an institution named otherwise and a diploma dated before the conferral, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A conferral record with no status and no date, a holder, degree or conferral date missing on either side, or a field of study on one side only leaves the diploma unverified. Names match without case, spacing or punctuation and in either order when written last name first, and degrees with common abbreviations spelled out, so B.S. and Bachelor of Science read as one. This reads an education-issued diploma against its conferral record: wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims against the evidence offered for them, and wever_single-credential-issue issues a human single-status credential under its own product, while the diploma check reads the holder, degree, field, conferral date and honors as printed against the conferral record. Verdict edu_diploma_mismatched, edu_diploma_partial, edu_diploma_unverified or edu_diploma_matched. POST /api/edu-diploma-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.
